ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels with high-intensity white spots; estimated white-to-black pixel ratio is approximately 0.03.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black (low-intensity) pixel region across both lobes; isolated white focal spots (approx. 5-15 pixels in diameter) are sparsely distributed with no contiguous white banding.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 35 degrees; depth corresponds to approximately 15% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel amplitude of peaks/valleys ranges from 4 to 12 pixels against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a sinuous sweep, starting concave near the median notch and transitioning to convex towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 15-20 high-contrast white circular spots (scarring) scattered across the ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of high-contrast, irregular geometric calcifications (barnacles) attached to the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme distal tips show significant profile distortion due to barnacle encrustation, extending the pixel boundary beyond the natural dermal edge.
